motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Approve the consent agenda
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the batch of routine items passed together in a single vote; the record does not list the individual items.
motions.impact: Routine housekeeping — nothing here changes for residents.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Steeplechase South Subdivision Second Plat Amendment (877 N Pony Express Parkway)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Steeplechase South Subdivision Second Plat Amendment (877 N Pony Express Parkway). Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Amend the Steeplechase South subdivision map
motions.summary: The city approved a second amendment to the recorded subdivision map for Steeplechase South, at 877 N Pony Express Parkway.
motions.impact: This touches the recorded map for one subdivision off Pony Express Parkway. Unless you own or are buying a lot there, nothing changes for you.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.35.140 for Right of Way Profile Illustrations
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.35.140 for Right of Way Profile Illustrations. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Update the city's street cross-section drawings
motions.summary: The council amended the code section that holds the illustrations showing how streets and rights of way must be laid out.
motions.impact: This is a technical drawing standard for developers and engineers designing new streets. Nothing changes for residents day to day.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.35.090 Privacy Screening, Section 17.40.020 Land Use Table, and Section 17.60.120 General Fencing Provisions
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.35.090 Privacy Screening, Section 17.40.020 Land Use Table, and Section 17.60.120 General Fencing Provisions. Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Update the rules on fencing and privacy screening
motions.summary: The council amended the code sections covering privacy screening, general fencing rules, and the table of land uses allowed in the city.
motions.impact: If you are putting up a fence or screening on your property, the requirements may not be what they were — check with city planning staff before you build. The motion itself does not spell out what changed.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Purchasing Policy Section 3.20.030 (H) to Modify the Approval Process for Change Orders
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Purchasing Policy Section 3.20.030 (H) to Modify the Approval Process for Change Orders. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Change who signs off on contract change orders
motions.summary: The city rewrote its purchasing rules to change how change orders — revisions to contracts the city has already signed — get approved.
motions.impact: This is internal housekeeping. It affects city staff and the contractors working on city projects, not what residents pay or see.

motions.item_title: Add traffic calming measures and traffic related actions to the Legislative Priorities List
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to add traffic calming measures and traffic related actions to the Legislative Priorities List. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Put traffic calming on the city's legislative wish list
motions.summary: The council added traffic calming and other traffic-related actions to the list of priorities the city takes to state lawmakers.
motions.impact: No speed bumps, signs, or street changes come out of this. It signals the city wants state help on traffic, but nothing on your street changes today.

motions.item_title: Add discussions with public safety partners and the Public Safety Director to include a Youth C…
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to add discussions with public safety partners and the Public Safety Director to include a Youth Court, Justice Court and other public Eagle Mountain City Council Agenda – June 3. 2025 Page 9 of 11 safety measures to the Legislative Priorities List. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Ask the Legislature for a youth court and justice court
motions.summary: The council added a youth court, a justice court, and other public safety measures to the list of priorities it will push with state lawmakers.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for you yet. This only sets what the city will ask the Legislature for; an actual court would need its own separate decision later.
